d: Her lightning aura is calming down and condensing along the katana as she draws it level in front of her chest; still crouching, same camera distance.

IMPORTANT: must be visibly different from both images, exactly halfway in pose and camera. Camera between them: shot from the waist up, she is slightly bigger than image 1, the katana level across her lower face.

IMPORTANT: must be visibly different from both images, exactly halfway in pose and camera. Camera between them: chest-up shot, her face a bit bigger than image 1 and smaller than image 2, eyes beginning to glow cyan, katana level across her face.

IMPORTANT: must be visibly different from both images, exactly halfway in pose and camera. Mid-spin: she twists her torso, both arms swinging the cyan katana around her in a wide arc, lightning crackling, motion blur.

IMPORTANT: must be visibly different from both images, exactly halfway in pose and camera. The camera pulls back from the close crouch toward the wide neon street with the torii gate; she is mid-size in frame, lunging low with the katana trailing a cyan arc.
Dashing forward, the rainbow afterimage clones (cyan, blue, magenta) stretch a little further behind her, stronger RGB split and speed lines.

IMPORTANT: must be visibly different from both images, exactly halfway in pose and camera. The three light streaks rising from the impact point grow longer and brighter; the three fighter silhouettes move higher along them.

IMPORTANT: must be visibly different from both images, exactly halfway in pose and camera. The three fighters separate further into the air along the light streaks; the streaks start to curve outward.

IMPORTANT: must be visibly different from both images, exactly halfway in pose and camera. The light at the center grows into a bright white flash between the clones; the girl starts to spin out toward the right side, katana trailing a cyan arc.

IMPORTANT: must be visibly different from both images, exactly halfway in pose and camera. The flash has faded to sparks; the girl spins out wide to the left with a big cyan-magenta sword arc, two faded clones behind her; the camera is pulling back.

IMPORTANT: must be visibly different from both images, exactly halfway in pose and camera. She flies diagonally across the frame, the sweeping cyan arc behind her starts to bend into the first stroke of an X slash.

IMPORTANT: must be visibly different from both images, exactly halfway in pose and camera. The neon X slash flares at its brightest, cyan and magenta strokes crossing; she lands one foot on the ground following through.

IMPORTANT: must be visibly different from both images, exactly halfway in pose and camera. Camera pushing toward her face: medium close-up, she grins, the katana sweeping across the foreground, X glow fading at the left edge.
IMPORTANT: must be visibly different from both images, exactly halfway in pose and camera. Wrapped in the cyan-magenta helix, she rises a bit higher above the cracked street between neon buildings.

IMPORTANT: must be visibly different from both images, exactly halfway in pose and camera. She shoots upward out of the helix toward the moon, smaller in frame, the helix stretching below her into a light pillar.
In front of the huge moon, plasma at her raised katana starts to stretch out to the left into a short glowing blade; lightning swirls around.

IMPORTANT: must be visibly different from both images, exactly halfway in pose and camera. The camera continues pulling back: the giant straight laser sword held out to the left, she is a bit smaller in front of the moon, the city skyline below.
She lifts the giant straight laser sword higher, rotating it upward over her head; lightning runs along the blade.
The giant laser sword swings down to the right, leaving a wide curved cyan-magenta trail; lightning everywhere.

IMPORTANT: must be visibly different from both images, exactly halfway in pose and camera. The light pillar shrinks to a thin beam, the shockwave ring expands outward, the first thick cyan-purple smoke billows up.
Her silhouette falls down through the smoke toward the crater, katana in hand, cyan sparks around her.
She lands in a deep kneel in the smoke, the ground splashes, lightning crackles along her katana.

IMPORTANT: must be visibly different from both images, exactly halfway in pose and camera. Rising from the kneel: knees half-bent, the katana sweeping up from the ground in a cyan arc; the robot cat flies closer.

IMPORTANT: must be visibly different from both images, exactly halfway in pose and camera. Camera slightly closer: she settles the katana on her shoulder, free hand on her hip, the robot cat drifts toward her.
Tiny change: her smile widens slightly and the cyan glow along the katana pulses brighter; the robot cat bobs up a little.
